description: Hand-labelled sentences for measuring PII detection. Each case lists every value that must be masked as [type, exact text]; cases with an empty list contain only look-alikes (organisations, places, headings, product names) that must not be masked. Card, IBAN and ID numbers are published test values, not real ones.
